[RFCS.26.3] **A new inject-class atom is not additive** ([RFCS.3.4]). An older
reader cannot skip a `CacheSeed` without starting the replay from another cache,
so it rejects the trace with `DS_ERR_FS_UNKNOWN_INJECT` ([RFCS.18.8]). The atom
therefore lands with a minor release ([LDET.1.10]).
